name: Grand Archipelago
description: Eight contestants race across eight islands: 200 spaces joined by bridges and ferries, each island with its own climate, tolls, traps, springs and festivals. Two star vendors wander the lookouts; the Demon guards the Volcano.

items.name: Healing Potion
items.aiHint: Drink it when your HP is low, especially before a fight you must win.

items.name: Smoke Bomb
items.description: Vanish in smoke: nobody can attack you until your next turn ends.
items.aiHint: Throw it when a much stronger rival could reach you next turn.

items.name: Shield Charm
items.aiHint: Break it before a risky fight: two hits are blocked.

items.name: Lucky Coin
items.description: Whoever holds it gains 1 extra gold whenever they gain gold. Others cannot see it.

items.name: Firecracker
items.description: Throw it at a rival on your space: 2d10 damage.
items.aiHint: Throw it at a rival on your space to soften them up before you attack, or to finish them off.

items.name: Spark Wand
items.description: Three charges: zap anyone on your space for 15 damage (once per round).
items.aiHint: Zap a rival or monster on your space; it recharges each round, three uses in all.

items.name: Trail Mix
items.aiHint: Eat it any time you are hurt; it does not use up your action.

statuses.name: Fish Form
statuses.description: Turned into a fish: tagged Fish, −1 Move, cannot shop.

statuses.name: Shielded
statuses.description: Each stack absorbs one hit completely.

enemies.name: Demon
enemies.description: Guards the center of the island. Worth two stars to whoever slays it.

enemies.name: Kraken
enemies.description: A boss from the deep. Attacks anyone who lands next to it; enraged below half HP.

effects.text: A witch cackles. {actor} is now a fish!

effects.prompt: A merchant offers you a deal.

options.label: Buy a Shield Charm for 6 gold
Buy a Healing Potion for 3 gold

effects.prompt: A stranger offers power for blood.

effects.text: A storm lashes the whole island.

else.text: The sea boils: the Kraken rises!

actions.name: Pickpocket
actions.description: Try to lift some gold from a contestant on your space.

actions.name: Go Fishing
actions.description: Cast a line from a blue space.

persona.voice: Theatrical pirate who brags in nautical metaphors and never apologizes.
behaviors: Picks fights when the odds favor you, then brags about it.
Saves gold for big purchases rather than small ones.

persona.voice: Precise scholar who calculates everything aloud and distrusts luck.
behaviors: Only fights when the numbers say you will almost surely win.

persona.voice: Cheerful swamp creature obsessed with snacks and shiny things.
behaviors: Goes wherever the most gold is.

persona.voice: Cold, ambitious duelist who speaks in short, cutting sentences.
behaviors: Hunts the strongest enemy she can beat.

persona.voice: Fiery monk who speaks in proverbs about patience and flame.
behaviors: Trains at every dojo and shrine she passes.
Keeps her promises, and expects the same.

persona.voice: Polite clockwork automaton that reports probabilities to two decimals.
behaviors: Takes the option with the best expected value.

persona.voice: Weathered fisherman, slow to anger, full of sea stories.
behaviors: Prefers Blue spaces and quiet coves.

persona.voice: Whispering thief who never says more than she must.
behaviors: Disappears when a fight turns against her.

provenance.sourceText: Whenever an uncursed contestant tagged as a fish lands on a blue space, give them two bananas.

rules.name: Old Well

rules.name: Demon Ambush

effects.text: The Star Vendor packs up and moves on.
